name: introspect-proxy-go
description: Go port of introspect-proxy (Caddy forward_auth Bearer check), shadow stage: runs next to the Python container on its own port, outside the request path, and logs a periodic decision comparison against it (ticket #1872)

native_build._doc: Multi-stage: compiled in golang:1.24-bookworm on the arch-matched runner, shipped as one static binary on distroless static (no shell, no libc, non-root 65532). No apt/apk line: the base has neither.

api.description: Same contract as introspect-proxy: validates bearer JWTs against the Authelia JWKS, ft_ tokens against tokens-api, mcpat_ tokens against mcp-oauth, for Caddy forward_auth.

shadow-compare.cmd: PYREF=$(ls -d /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11*/x64/bin/python3 2>/dev/null | tail -1); ${PYREF:-python3} -m venv /tmp/ip-shadow-venv && /tmp/ip-shadow-venv/bin/pip install -q -r ../../../infra-sec_introspect-proxy/src/code/requirements.txt && PY_BIN=/tmp/ip-shadow-venv/bin/python PY_APP_DIR=$PWD/../../../infra-sec_introspect-proxy/src/code go test -count=1 -tags shadow -v -run TestShadowCompare ./shadow/
shadow-compare._doc: Reference = the Python service under gunicorn in a venv on CPython 3.11 when the runner has it (production image is python:3.11-slim); see shadow/harness_test.go.

_doc_addressing: No mesh name on purpose during the shadow stage: nothing dials this container but itself (the comparison loop, at its bind address 10.0.0.1:4186), so it needs no Hickory row and no Caddy fallback-map entry; Caddy's forward_auth is untouched until the switch-over.
